"""Produce five pressure-controlled calligraphic pen passes in the frozen scene."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def main():
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json')
    s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    quat=s.tip_down_quat(-np.deg2rad(35))
    print('initial pose',s.tip_pose(),flush=True)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.065],quat,speed=.06,settle=10)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.0265],quat,speed=.012,settle=10)
    print('loaded',s.brush_state(),flush=True)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.055],quat,speed=.02,settle=6)
    data=np.load(OUT/'pen_paths.npz')
    for i in range(5):
        raw=data[f'path{i}']
        # Resample each scribe's pass at a constant low writing speed.
        d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(raw[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]*s.geo.px_m
        unique=np.r_[True,np.diff(d)>1e-10];d=d[unique];raw=raw[unique]
        speed=.003
        ts=np.linspace(0,d[-1],int(np.ceil(d[-1]/(speed/20)))+1)
        path=np.array([np.interp(ts,d,raw[:,j]) for j in range(3)]).T
        xy=np.array(s.geo.px_to_world(path[:,0],path[:,1])).T
        width=path[:,2]
        # 0.7 mm is a reliable hairline contact; flex starts at 1 mm.
        depth=np.where(width<=.40001,.00075,.001+(width-.4)/1.6*.0025)
        pos=np.c_[xy,.02-depth]
        start=pos[0].copy();start[2]=.028
        p['move_tip'](start,quat,speed=.03,settle=10)
        p['move_tip'](pos[0],quat,speed=.004,settle=8)
        trace=[]
        for target in pos[1:]:
            q,ok,err=s.ik(target,quat)
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError(f'IK {i} {err}')
            s.step(q)
            trace.append([*target,*s.tip_pose()[0]])
        p['hold'](10)
        end=pos[-1].copy();end[2]=.028
        p['move_tip'](end,quat,speed=.006,settle=10)
        np.save(OUT/f'trace{i}.npy',trace)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'tip',s.tip_pose()[0],flush=True)
    p['hold'](20)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png')
    np.save(OUT/'ink.npy',s.ink())
    for j,stroke in enumerate(s.strokes()):np.save(OUT/f'stroke{j}.npy',stroke['samples'])
    print('state',s.state_sha(),'actions',len(actions),flush=True)
    status=s.status();print(json.dumps(status,indent=2),flush=True)
    (OUT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
